```yaml
name: Fuzzing

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  property-tests:
    name: Property-based tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        timeout-minutes: 2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
        timeout-minutes: 2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest hypothesis
        timeout-minutes: 5

      - name: Run property tests
        run: pytest --maxfail=1 --junitxml=test-results.xml
        timeout-minutes: 10

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: property-test-results
          path: test-results.xml
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 2

  atheris-fuzz:
    name: Atheris fuzzing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        timeout-minutes: 2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
        timeout-minutes: 2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install atheris
        timeout-minutes: 5

      - name: Run Atheris fuzzing
        run: |
          python -m atheris fuzz -c src/py3plex -o fuzz_output
        timeout-minutes: 1

      - name: Upload fuzzing artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fuzz-output
          path: fuzz_output
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 2
```
